01-basit.text: Twelve cartons came in, from Harbor Foods.

02-sayi-sonda.text: Harbor Foods' sunflower oil is here, eleven cartons in total.

03-duzeltme.text: I said twenty-four cartons, but I miscounted. It's actually twenty-two.

04-belirsiz.text: Some of the cartons are stacked, I couldn't count them all. Twelve, I think.
